main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 5-day return of forecast>0 grid bars

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, cases of one day grouped

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passed; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; fewer than 30 cases inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-day return, upper minus lower half at median forecast

decided_by: The t of the weighted mean excess return lies between -2 and 2. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction -0.942 (below 1), 118 cases (30 needed).
reading: Heavy volume is the mean of bars t-2..t over the mean of bars t-22..t-3 recomputed from the window's volumes (the recorded regime where fewer bars exist), the rise is close[t]/close[t-3]-1>0, and the falling-calm profile (60-bar fall, 365-bar volatility percentile) is read from the regime being 'trending' since it cannot be rebuilt from the recorded bars; the median split puts cases above the median forecast in the upper half and the rest in the lower half, halves compared unweighted; the t is the forecast-weighted mean over its day-clustered standard error.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction -0.942 (below 1), 118 cases (30 needed)
